title: Home Insurance Renewal Renewal Premium Leaderboard
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeinsurance:renewal renewal_premium_usd=*
| stats sum(renewal_premium_usd) as total_value, avg(renewal_premium_usd) as avg_value by policy_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks policy values by total and average renewal premium across home insurance renewal events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `renewal_premium_usd` values for each home insurance renewal event and review total and average renewal premium by policy.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total renewal premium.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which policy shows the biggest renewal premium numbers in your home insurance renewal data.
